The '''Mon Calamari light freighter''' was a model of [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. Produced by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], it was similar in design to the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]].<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
